name: Tirolerhof
beschreibung: The Tirolerhof is situated in one of North Tyrol's scenic valleys, surrounded by lush meadows and fragrant woodlands. The property unites traditional Tyrolean architecture with tasteful, well-maintained interiors. Guests can immerse themselves in a tranquil atmosphere shaped by the alpine backdrop. The offering includes regional culinary classics and spotlessly clean, comfortable rooms – an ideal haven for travellers who appreciate the splendour of the mountains and nature.
